text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Believe was running a different 
route than usual for her personal 
training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... phew.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(First set finished. Now, a quick 
five-minute break—)

text_block_list.name: Grandma A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. Another Umamusume! —Here now, you 
come on over too. Take a rest."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. You should just accept this kind 
of goodwill openly~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"It's break time for you too, right, 
Believe-san? Then taking a little break 
shouldn't hurt, should it?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So, whenever I eat store-bought 
tsukudani... I can't help but compare it 
to Grandma's cooking.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I just prefer it mild... Because 
that's the taste of my memories...

text_block_list.name: Grandma A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your grandmother must be so happy to 
see her cute granddaughter enjoying it so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Grandma A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Ours is lightly seasoned too, 
the tsukudani. Want to come over and have 
some?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm so glad Believe-san came to 
help~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me, that little chit-chat 
would've broken up pretty fast, you know? 
All right! Time to get pampered to the 
max~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...So that was your scheme all along.

text_block_list.name: Grandma A
text_block_list.text:
Here, I brought some tsukudani. And also, 
Seiji-san from the neighborhood said he'd 
bring some apples.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay! I'll eat, I'll eat~!

text_block_list.name: Grandma B
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some of my ohagi too. It's 
sweet and super tasty, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Burp... Grandma, everyone? Sei-chan's 
already totally stuffed, so I'm good on 
food, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grandpa A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that so? But Miwa-san said she'd 
bring over some simmered potatoes.

text_block_list.name: Grandma C
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day we have Umamusume 
visiting us. We grandmas just want to show 
you some proper hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, huh? Believe-san? Are you sure 
you're okay eating that much?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohagi, rice crackers, mitarashi dango, 
dried persimmons, tsukudani—you don't have 
to eat everything they serve you, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No. I'm fine. I'll burn it off during 
training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since you went through the trouble of 
giving it to me, I don't want to leave any 
leftovers.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's the thought that counts, so I'm 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
They're all delicious. Simple, and not too 
heavy...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It tastes like something I really like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking along the riverbed, 
I ran into Believe during her personal 
training.
choice_data_list: Good work! Is training going well?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No. Today... I took a bit too long of a 
break, so I was thinking of pushing myself 
hard now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to her... today's self-training 
progressed quite leisurely, with elderly 
ladies treating her to home-cooked meals 
and treats along the way."
choice_data_list:
I would've loved to try that tsukudani 
too.
I wanted to try some too, the tsukudani

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to her... today's self-training 
progressed quite leisurely, with elderly 
ladies treating her to home-cooked meals 
and treats along the way."
choice_data_list:
I would've loved to try that tsukudani 
too.
I wanted to try some too, the tsukudani

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll make up for it. With training. 
Starting right now."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Since I ate, I've gotta burn it off. More 
than anything...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Because that's what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, someone shared some with me. 
I'll bring them to the Trainer's office 
tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If you want to thank someone, not me... 
thank everyone who gave them to us.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. I need to bring... a thank-you 
gift next time too."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wonder what would be good...
